reports.summary:
J-media-io parity work is finished. I built and ran the predecessor's two bridge fixes in 3c690eb2a0 (Stop state, audio-only subtitles). The native contracts and media suites pass on the real tree. Each new runtime check fails when its fix is removed: without the guard, a stopped job publishes finishing, finishing, cancelled; without the audio-only rule, the aac output probes as audio + subtitle. Nothing was half-done or temporarily reverted; I kept all of it and changed none of it.

Swift-side changes:
- The overwrite decision is now a tested value type, ConversionDestination in MXRCore, and the Convert form uses it.
- The Stream host name comes from the output backend. The mock returns the fixed name "Studio-Mac", so the gallery render no longer shows the build machine's name.
- Open Disc and Open Capture Device are now as tall as their content (713×434 and 713×345, both computed from tokens) instead of 589 with empty space below.
- The Stream address, port and path fields have visible labels.
- pathFieldWidth and the progress-bar height are now named metrics in MXRDesign. The progress bar no longer uses a spacing token as a height.

`swift build` is green and OutputModelTests (7) and OutputAdapterTests pass. No live UI was run.

Runtime check passes on the real tree (../build/evidence/final4/J-media-io/native-media.log, 'PASS: real VLC conversion…'). Mutation without the guard fails with states (finishing, finishing, cancelled): ../build/evidence/final4/J-media-io/mut-stop-guard.log

(d)/critic P1(2)/areas open[1] audio-only profiles kept the source's subtitles: MXRMediaServices.m:228-235 adds no-sout-spu for audio/aac/wav (predecessor's, kept). The runtime test muxes a mov_text mp4 with ffmpeg; ffprobe then reads only audio streams in each audio output, and the test passes. Mutation (audioOnly = NO) fails with 'aac output keeps only the sound: (audio, subtitle)': ../build/evidence/final4/J-media-io/mut-audio-only.log. The options contract passes in native-contracts.log ('PASS: native media output contracts').

New tests in Tests/MXRCoreTests/OutputModelTests.swift: testOnlyAConfirmedDestinationIsReplacedSilently (a format change renames the destination and loses the confirmation, Replace confirms, completion clears it; checked against MockOutput's EEXIST) and testAResumedJobsDestinationIsNotConfirmed. The test fails when the rename keeps the confirmation or completion keeps it (mutation run, 3 assertion failures). The tests pass after the fix.

VLCOutputBackend reads SCDynamicStoreCopyLocalHostName; MockOutput returns 'Studio-Mac'; the form reads app.output.localHostName. verdict.summary:
J-media-io passes independent verification, round 1. No blocker or major remains.

**Tree state.** Checked at HEAD 3c690eb2a0 plus the uncommitted working tree. The engine is untouched: `git diff upstream-base-2026-10-14 -- src lib include modules/gui/macosx` is empty. No new DECISIONS entries were written. The Settings gate files were not touched. Swift 6 is clean: an isolated rebuild of the area's files gave no warnings or errors.

**(d) Stop overwritten by 'finishing': fixed.** `outputStopping` in MXRMediaServices.m:625 keeps `stopping` when `cancelRequested` is set. The runtime test now records every output state published after Stop and allows only stopping then cancelled. I re-ran `native-tests.py --suite media` and `--suite contracts` under the lock myself, and both pass. The fixer's mutation log shows the test fails without the guard (finishing, finishing, cancelled).

**(d) Audio-only profiles keeping subtitles: fixed.** The audio, aac and wav profiles now get `no-sout-spu`. The contracts test checks the options for all three. The runtime test muxes a mov_text source with ffmpeg and requires ffprobe to find only audio in each output; it passes. The mutation log shows it fails without the fix (aac = audio + subtitle).

**(d)/(c) J-03 overwrite logic: fixed.** The logic now lives in a value type, `ConversionDestination` (OutputModel.swift), and OutputMediaForm uses it for the save panel, format change, Replace, completion and a resumed job. In an isolated copy I ran two mutations:
- Making `completed()` a no-op fails `testOnlyAConfirmedDestinationIsReplacedSilently`.
- Keeping the confirmation after `changeExtension` also fails it, with 3 failures.

The tests check behaviour against MockOutput's EEXIST handling, not one-line predicates.

**(d) Stream host name: fixed.** It now comes from `OutputBackend.localHostName`: VLCOutputBackend reads SystemConfiguration, and MockOutput returns a fixed name. My render of S37.Stream/running shows http://Studio-Mac.local:8080/live, so the gallery render is now deterministic.

**(d) J-12: fixed.** `Theme.Metric.streamPathFieldWidth` and `outputProgressHeight` are in the new MXRDesign/Theme/OutputDialogMetrics.swift. OutputProgressBar no longer uses `Theme.Spacing.gap4` as a height.

**(a) Open Disc and Open Capture Device: fixed.** Both dialogs are now as tall as their content, computed from tokens (713×434 and 713×344.5). I looked at both renders; the large empty area is gone.

**(a) Stream field labels: fixed.** Address, Port and Path labels sit above the fields. The fields' accessibility labels match, and the visual labels are hidden from accessibility so VoiceOver reads each name once.

**(a) Convert "focus ring": correctly no change.** I compared it with Figma 999:5047. The outline is the Figma dropdown's dark well, and the disabled dropdown drops it (Disc, Capture, Convert running).

**J-10 wording: done by another area.** Both menus now use the same wording.

**Left open (minor, not J's files).** In Light, the DialogButton secondary tile vanishes into the opaque dialog surface. It is handed to the DialogSupport owner (see issues).

**Renders, built with swift build and looked at.** Disc, Capture, Convert empty, running and light, Stream empty, running and light, and App convert-compact. S36 Network Stream still matches Figma (REVIEW, mean Δ 0.50, 0.014 % structural, the same corner antialias as before).

**Targeted tests.** These pass on the shared tree: OutputModelTests (7), OutputAdapterTests, OpenMediaIOTests and DialogsTests.

**Edits outside ownership** are small and listed by the fixer: two cases in MXRDialogHost, two gallery sizes in DialogsGallery, the new token file in MXRDesign, and tests. The DialogKeyLoopGuard work in MXRDialogHost belongs to another agent and was left intact.

Evidence is in ../build/evidence/final4/J-media-io-verify-r1/: r/*.png, native-media.log and native-contracts.log. The isolated copy was deleted after use.

issues.description: In Light, the secondary DialogButton tile (BG/A3) is the same colour as the opaque Light dialog surface (D045). 'Choose…' and Cancel read as plain text in Convert, Stream and every DialogShell dialog (r/S37_Convert_empty_light.png). DialogButton already takes a `fill:` parameter (added for Add Subtitles), but DialogShell dialogs do not use it in Light. The fixer correctly handed this to the DialogSupport owner.

The heights include the dialogHint line height of 24.5, so they end in a half point: Capture is 713×344.5 and Stream is 713×679.5. On a 1x display the sheet frame can then land on half-pixel edges. Cosmetic; rounding the sum to whole points would avoid it.

The new J-03 tests cover the ConversionDestination value type, and the mutations confirm they catch regressions. The wiring in OutputMediaForm (the onChange of state to completed, and Replace) is still checked only by reading the code, which I did. The live check J-overwrite covers the real flow.
